notes: A fresh approval is required after a review-invalidating push because dismiss_stale_reviews and require_last_push_approval are enabled.
GitHub does not allow a pull request author to approve their own PR; the independent-review requirement therefore cannot be satisfied by self-approval.
The mandatory check is the existing 'portable' job from the 'Portable profiler correctness' workflow.
Unattended interactive EU4 execution remains outside CI: live qualification is a separate explicit test profile.
